{{Quote|One does not build the groundwork for promotion by reporting failure.|[[Beyghor Sahdett]], on Ransley|<ref name="Dark Times—Out of the Wilderness 3">[[Dark Times—Out of the Wilderness 3|''Dark Times—Out of the Wilderness'' 3]]</ref>}}
'''Ransley''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. He commanded the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] [[Harvester (starship)|''Harvester'']].

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the ''Harvester'' intercepted [[Dezono Qua's starship|the]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of [[Dezono Qua]] by the desert world of [[Prine]]. However, Qua's ship was being flown by wanted [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] fugitive [[Dass Jennir]], after having killed the vessel's former owner. When Jennir refused to stand by and be boarded and instead attempted to make for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], Ransley gave the order for two [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|Alpha-3 ''Nimbus''-class V-wing starfighters]] to destroy Jennir's ship.

While the V-wings were successful in bringing the civilian ship down, Jennir managed to trick the two fighters into colliding, destroying them. Despite the survival of both the Jedi and his [[Ember Chankeli|companion]] in the crash, Ransley subsequently reported that the ship was destroyed to preserve the possibility of advancement through the ranks, a detail capitalized on by [[Beyghor Sahdett]], who had downloaded Ransley's reports in attempt at finding Jennir.
